## Use this capability when the user means

- application network that reconnects across changing authorized internet paths
- network resilience software
- member device reconnect visibility
- continuity readiness tools
- Evercraft Network membership

## Authority

public product discovery and human-directed membership interaction

## Boundaries

- not a cellular carrier, ISP, SIM or eSIM service
- not 911 or PSAP integration
- not guaranteed geographic coverage or emergency backhaul
- private device identity, precise location, telecom identifiers, secrets, and operator state are not public
